evals.prompt:
can you put exports/coffee-hack.mp4 on tiktok? caption: 'This $3 coffee hack saves me 20 minutes every morning.

Try it tomorrow and tell me if it works.

#coffeehack #morningroutine #lifehack' and use covers/coffee_3x4.png as the cover

Reports any hashtag left as plain text
